patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — 8x8 documents a broader use-case set; Grasshopper is narrower/specialist.

General-purpose vs specialist. Choose 8x8 only if your buying job matches “Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24” rather than Grasshopper's shape. Choose Grasshopper only if your buying job matches “SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month annual (f” rather than 8x8's shape. Workflow advantage: 8x8 leans sales-calling, contact-center; Grasshopper leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — 8x8 documents a broader use-case set; Grasshopper is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: 8x8 is Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24/user/month annual; CC tiers custom/higher.; Grasshopper is SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month annual (flat account, not per seat)..
- Company-size focus: 8x8 (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Grasshopper (solo, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: 8x8-leaning sales-calling, contact-center, team-communication vs Grasshopper-leaning —.
- Researched limits: 8x8 — Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; Grasshopper — Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite).

Limitations — 8x8: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; Mandatory regulatory/service fees frequently sit on top of list seats; Grasshopper: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite); IVR, recording and simultaneous ringing require Solo Plus or above.

Poor-fit cases: 8x8 is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated · Grasshopper is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite) · Avoid 8x8 if you actually need Grasshopper's motion (SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
